text: DSH UI Models Invert Selection 是面向 Web 客户端的 DSH 插件，在模型设置的抓取/添加模型对话框中加入“反选”按钮。插件通过观察对话框 DOM 找到候选列表和操作栏，克隆现有按钮样式，并让每个候选复选框逐一切换，使对话框沿用原有状态更新流程。适合在再次抓取模型后快速保留已添加模型的选择。无需额外密钥或服务。

A DSH Web client plugin that adds an “Invert selection” button to the model fetch dialog. It clones the existing button style and toggles each candidate checkbox through its normal change path. Keeps already added models selected during another fetch pass; no extra key is needed.
想在抓取模型时一键反选候选列表里的复选框
模型设置里能不能快速只勾选已经添加的模型？
让 DSH 的模型抓取对话框增加反选按钮
再次获取模型时，我想把当前选择全部切换
How can I invert all model checkboxes in the fetch dialog?
I want to keep the models already in my list selected during another fetch pass.
模型抓取列表太长，想一次切换所有勾选状态。
Can I flip every candidate checkbox at once?
DSH UI Models Invert Selection 的功能「反选候选模型」：在模型抓取/添加对话框的操作栏提供反选按钮。点击后逐个点击候选列表中的复选框，切换当前选择状态。
DSH UI Models Invert Selection 的功能「动态发现对话框」：初次扫描页面并监听 DOM 新增节点，发现候选操作栏后注入按钮；支持 candidateActions 与 candidateToolbar 两种类名。
DSH UI Models Invert Selection 的功能「中英文按钮文案」：根据原操作按钮文本检测中文字符，设置对应的“反选”或“Invert selection”标签及提示。

@furayoshi/dsh-ui-models-invert-selection README · Specific tag：dsh plugin --profile web add @furayoshi/dsh-ui-models-invert-selection@github:FraYoshi/dsh-ui-models-invert-selection#v1.0.0

@furayoshi/dsh-ui-models-invert-selection README · Specific commit：dsh plugin --profile web add @furayoshi/dsh-ui-models-invert-selection@github:FraYoshi/dsh-ui-models-invert-selection#a1b2c3d4
```

@furayoshi/dsh-ui-models-invert-selection README · From local source (for hacking)：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @furayoshi/dsh-ui-models-invert-selection@file:/home/<you>/work/dsh-ui-models-invert-selection
```

After editing `lib/client.js`, re-link inside the profile:

```sh
rm -rf node_modules/@furayoshi && pnpm install
```

Then restart DSH.

@furayoshi/dsh-ui-models-invert-selection README · Verify：Open the Web UI → **Settings → Models → Fetch / Add models**. You should see a new **"Invert selection"** button next to the existing action button. Click it — every checkbox in the candidate list flips once.

To confirm the bundle loaded:

```sh
dsh web --dump-config | grep -i "invert-selection\|furayoshi"
```
